description: [Trackly Apply (cloud)] Trackly applies for you; nothing runs on your computer. Requests Trackly Apply (cloud) for one Trackly job: Trackly applies to the employer for the user with the account's default resume and every saved application profile answer, sensitive ones included, then notifies the user. Nothing runs on the user's computer. This differs from Trackly Apply (local), where the user's own AI agent fills the application in the user's browser and stops before Submit for the user to submit; that uses the Trackly Apply (local) tools and the Trackly Apply skill, not this one. It also differs from trackly_update_status with action=applied, which only records an application the user made themselves. Supported for US postings on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby job boards; search results mark them with autoApplySupported. Calling this tool is the user's instruction to apply, so it is for a job the user has explicitly asked Trackly to apply to, never a suggestion. Each request counts toward the account's Trackly Apply (cloud) allowance. Returns the request with its status; trackly_auto_apply_status reports progress later. It does not fill a browser form.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

jobId.description: Numeric Trackly job ID from trackly_search_jobs. Employer requisition IDs and URLs are not Trackly job IDs.
